mapper.select: SELECT c.ent_time, c.id, c.car_stat, c.ex_time, c.cost, c.spc_no, c.discnt_at, m.car_num, c.car_id FROM car c JOIN member m ON c.id = m.id WHERE m.car_num LIKE CONCAT('%', #{carNum}) AND c.car_stat = 1 ORDER BY c.ent_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET discnt_time = discnt_time - 2 WHERE id = #{ownerId} AND discnt_time >= 2
mapper.select: SELECT c.ent_time, c.id, c.car_stat, c.ex_time, c.cost, c.spc_no, c.discnt_at, m.car_num FROM car c JOIN member m ON c.id = m.id WHERE c.discnt_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY c.discnt_at DESC

SELECT c.car_id, c.ent_time, c.id, c.car_stat, c.ex_time, c.cost, c.spc_no, c.discnt_at, c.discnt_owner_id, m.car_num FROM car c JOIN member m ON c.id = m.id WHERE c.discnt_owner_id = #{ownerId} AND c.discnt_at >= CURRENT_DATE AND c.discnt_at < CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '1 day' ORDER BY c.discnt_at DESC

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN c.ent_time >= CURRENT_DATE AND c.ent_time < CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '1 day' THEN 1 END) AS entry_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN c.ex_time >= CURRENT_DATE AND c.ex_time < CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '1 day' THEN 1 END) AS exit_count FROM car c

SELECT h.hour AS hour, COUNT(c.ent_time) AS cnt FROM generate_series(0, 23) AS h(hour) LEFT JOIN car c ON EXTRACT(HOUR FROM c.ent_time) = h.hour AND c.ent_time >= #{date}::date AND c.ent_time < #{date}::date + INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY h.hour ORDER BY h.hour

SELECT d.stat_date AS stat_date, EXTRACT(DOW FROM d.stat_date) AS dow, COUNT(c.ent_time) AS cnt FROM generate_series(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 day', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day', INTERVAL '1 day') AS d(stat_date) LEFT JOIN car c ON DATE(c.ent_time) = d.stat_date GROUP BY d.stat_date ORDER BY d.stat_date
